## Problem and result

Explain the concrete problem and the resulting behavior. Link the issue.

## Validation

List commands and relevant evidence. For performance changes, include a reproducible workload, machine details and baseline comparison.

## Limitations

Describe assumptions, unsupported behavior and remaining work.

## Publication review

- [ ] No credentials, private planning, account data or personal trading records are included.
- [ ] Any external data/code has compatible redistribution rights and attribution.
- [ ] I have the right to contribute this change under Apache-2.0.
